question: Which cricket player received the Padma Bhushan Award 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahendra Singh Dhoni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mahendra Singh Dhoni, commonly known as MS Dhoni, is a former Indian cricketer and captain of the Indian national team.
 
• Under his captaincy, India won the 2007 ICC World Twenty20, the 2010 and 2016 Asia Cups, the 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup, and the 2013 ICC Champions Trophy.
 
• Dhoni is known for his exceptional wicket-keeping skills and is considered one of the best finishers in limited-overs cricket.
 
• In recognition of his contributions to Indian cricket, Dhoni was awarded the Padma Bhushan, India's third-highest civilian award, in 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Bhushan**

 
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in the Republic of India, preceded by the Bharat Ratna and the Padma Vibhushan and followed by the Padma Shri.
 
• Instituted in 1954, the award is given for "distinguished service of a high order" without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex.
 
• The recommendations for the award are made by the Padma Awards Committee, constituted by the Prime Minister of India.
 
• The awardees are announced on Republic Day (26th January) every year.
 
 
 
• **MS Dhoni's Career**
 
 
• MS Dhoni made his debut in international cricket in December 2004 and quickly established himself as a key player in the Indian team.
 
• He became the captain of the Indian team in 2007 and led India to numerous victories in all formats of the game.
 
• Dhoni is known for his calm demeanor, strategic acumen, and leadership qualities.
 
• He retired from international cricket on 15 August 2020 but continues to play in the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Awards**
 
 
• Dhoni has been honored with several other prestigious awards, including the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna in 2007 and the Padma Shri in 2009.
 
• He was also named the ICC ODI Player of the Year in 2008 and 2009.
